descriptor.value: Comfort qualification initializes without requesting thermal service
Climate request and thermal relation form a total comfort classification
Visibility qualification initializes invalid so no service is inferred
Glazing validity precedes combined user and glazing demand
Energy capability initializes invalid until a complete context is qualified
The three EnergyContext attributes form the ordered capability relation
Recovery authority initializes inhibited and awaiting a fresh request
Invalid energy always inhibits and cannot be overridden by freshness
Unavailable energy always inhibits and cannot be overridden by freshness
Usable energy without a fresh request cannot rearm an inhibited authority
Usable energy and a fresh request rearm an inhibited authority for this evaluation
An armed authority remains armed while energy stays usable
Service selection initializes off with the inhibited reason
Recovery authority blocks every qualified demand and preserves the block reason
Invalid qualified comfort or visibility blocks service when authority permits
Required visibility service outranks simultaneous valid heating or cooling demand
Valid heating demand is selected when visibility demand is absent
Valid cooling demand is selected when visibility demand is absent
Within-range comfort yields an off selection with hold reason
No comfort or visibility demand yields an off selection with user-off reason
Resource allocation initializes with no grant
An off service receives no resource grant
Defrost is full, heat-assisted, vent-only, or fail-closed by capability
Heating is full, economy, denied, or fail-closed by capability
Cooling is full, denied under reduction, or fail-closed by capability
Command coordination initializes to the complete quiescent tuple
Off, denied, and incompatible combinations are quiescent with distinct dispositions
Unknown fan preference suppresses every otherwise compatible active command
Known fan preference produces the unique permitted heat or cool cabin tuple
Known fan preference produces the unique permitted glazing tuple
Public status initializes inhibited with recovery authority
Status composes owner facts in the approved fault, recovery, inactivity, limitation, and service order
